title: Holiday Terms: Floor on Room Reservations Late Cancellation Penalties
content:
## Holiday terms

Holiday terms set a floor under the share of the penalty night that a late cancellation of a Room Reservations reservation owes: when the arrival night is in the peak season and the stay is at least 5 nights, the share charged is never less than the holiday long-stay floor of 75%; when the arrival night is in the peak season and the stay is shorter than 5 nights, or the arrival night is in the standard season and the stay is at least 7 nights, it is never less than the holiday short-stay floor of 60%; any other stay has no floor (0%).

The award season is the one recorded on the reservation for the arrival night; the stay is the nights from the arrival date to the departure date. A floor raises a lower share to the floor and leaves a share at or above the floor as it is.

## Floor by season and stay

| Award season of the arrival night | Stay | Floor under the share |
|---|---|---|
| Peak | 5 nights or more | 75% |
| Peak | 4 nights or fewer | 60% |
| Standard | 7 nights or more | 60% |
| Standard | 6 nights or fewer | none |
| Off-peak | any | none |

## Cases (hypothetical shares)

| Season and stay | Share before the floor | Floor | Share charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Peak, 6 nights | 50% | 75% | 75% |
| Peak, 3 nights | 75% | 60% | 75% |
| Standard, 7 nights | 50% | 60% | 60% |
| Standard, 6 nights | 50% | none | 50% |
| Off-peak, 10 nights | 50% | none | 50% |
| Peak, 5 nights | 100% | 75% | 100% |
